service_worker.behavior: Caches shell/static assets; ignores API requests; navigation falls back to cached '/'.
service_worker.registration: Registered in OfflineProvider only when NODE_ENV=production and serviceWorker available.

installability.note: Installability requires secure context (HTTPS) or localhost. The app exposes manifest + service worker but registration occurs only in production build. Local dev may not fully exercise installability. Marked PARTIAL.

cache_strategy: Shell & static caching; API requests are not cached by service worker.
offline_fallback: Navigation requests fall back to cached '/' when fetch fails.
api_offline_behavior: Service worker ignores API; frontend implements IndexedDB queue + sync-controller for offline writes.

offline_write_support.notes: Frontend queues create/update/delete operations into IndexedDB; sync executor calls transactionService which posts to backend. Backend implements idempotency via reference_number. End-to-end runtime validation requires backend running and reachable.

online_offline_state_handling: useNetworkStatus and OfflineProvider exist; offline banners and sync status present.
data_safety_when_offline: Client assigns reference_number to queued transactions and backend deduplicates via reference_number; update merges with pending create; delete cancels pending create—these are protective rules at code level. Runtime validation blocked.
